proof.text: Put $r=|K|$. Lagrange gives $re=n$ with $r,e>0$. The monic quotient relations give $H$-bases $t^i$ for $0\le i<n$ and $s^j$ for $0\le j<e$. The map takes $s^j$ to $t^{rj}$, with distinct exponents below $n$, so comparison of coefficients proves injectivity.

Choose a generator $\zeta$ of $K$ of order $r$. It acts on $t^i$ by $\zeta^i t^i$. For $r\nmid i$, $\zeta^i$ is nonidentity and $\zeta^i-1$ is a unit; invariance forces the coefficient at $i$ to vanish. For $r\mid i$, every element of $K$ fixes $t^i$, since its rth power is one.

The surviving exponents are exactly $rj$ for $j<e$. Every fixed element is the image of the sum of these coefficients times $s^j$, and every such image is fixed. This proves the image characterization.

title: Power-map image equals fixed elements in a root algebra
statement: Let $H$ be a commutative ring, $h\in H$, and $n>0$. Put $G=\{\zeta\in H^\times:\zeta^n=1\}$. Assume $G$ is finite cyclic of cardinality $n$, and $\zeta-1$ is a unit for every nonidentity $\zeta\in G$. Let $K\subseteq G$ be a subgroup and $e=[G:K]$. Put $C=H[t]/(t^n-h)$ and $D=H[s]/(s^e-h)$, with $t,s$ the quotient classes of the polynomial variables. Given $H$-algebra homomorphisms $\rho_\zeta:C\to C$ for $\zeta\in G$ with $\rho_\zeta(t)=\zeta t$, and an $H$-algebra homomorphism $\phi:D\to C$ with $\phi(s)=t^{|K|}$, the map $\phi$ is injective and, for each $x\in C$, $x$ is fixed by every $\rho_\zeta$ for $\zeta\in K$ if and only if $x$ lies in the image of $\phi$.

theorem root_power_map_invariants
    (H : Type u) [CommRing H] (h : H) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    [Finite (rootsOfUnity n H)] [IsCyclic (rootsOfUnity n H)]
    (hcard : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n H) = n)
    (hsep : ∀ ζ : rootsOfUnity n H, ζ ≠ 1 → IsUnit (((ζ : Hˣ) : H) - 1))
    (K : Subgroup (rootsOfUnity n H))
    (ρ : rootsOfUnity n H →
      (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h) →ₐ[H]
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h)))
    (hρ : ∀ ζ, ρ ζ (AdjoinRoot.root
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h)) =
        algebraMap H _ ((ζ : Hˣ) : H) * AdjoinRoot.root _)
    (φ : AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ K.index - Polynomial.C h) →ₐ[H]
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h))
    (hφ : φ (AdjoinRoot.root _) =
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C h) ^ Nat.card K) :
    Function.Injective φ ∧ ∀ x, (∀ ζ : K, ρ ζ.val x = x) ↔ x ∈ Set.range φ
